tspan.tspan: Open to all DTU students, employees, and alumni
All voices welcome - no experience required
No fee or sign-up - simply show up at any rehearsal
Repertoire spanning from The Beatles to Billie Eilish
Scan the code, or look for DTU University Choir on Facebook
Rehearsals at DTU Lyngby every Thursday at 17:00 - 18:30
(locations announced weekly in our Facebook group)
